title: Build a Real Estate WhatsApp Bot in Claude Code #Shorts
description:
Real estate agencies lose buyers due to slow WhatsApp replies. Build a lightweight Node.js/Python lead qualifier bot using Claude Code and Twilio. Keep conversation flows short to minimize messaging fees.

1. Run Claude Code in terminal to generate an Express server handling Twilio WhatsApp webhooks
2. Prompt Claude Code to parse buyer budgets, preferred locations, and purchasing timelines from chat logs
3. Deploy the backend app to cloud hosting and automatically push qualified leads directly to broker CRMs

Tool used:
- name: Claude Code CLI
- endpoint: claude "Build an Express.js webhook server using Twilio and Claude API to ask real estate buyers their budget and location preference"
- docs: Claude Code CLI Overview

app.py (python) - Project directory root as app.py:
from flask import Flask, request
from twilio.twiml.messaging_response import MessagingResponse
import anthropic

app = Flask(__name__)
client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY")

@app.route("/whatsapp", methods=["POST"])
def reply():
    incoming_msg = request.values.get('Body', '')
    resp = MessagingResponse()
    prompt = f"Extract buyer budget/location from: {incoming_msg}. Keep reply under 20 words."
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model="claude-3-5-haiku-20241022",
        max_tokens=100,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
    )
    resp.message(msg.content[0].text)
    return str(resp)

The catch: WhatsApp API messaging fees add up quickly if the automated conversation flow is not kept concise.
